title: [PC/PS/XBOX] Patch Notes – June 26
author: Khazan_CM
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/9acfc33173e0e1c1189e17effe483211d3d6c734.png[/img]
[b]📢 [PC] Latest AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR) Feature Applied[/b]

Hello Berserkers,
With this update, the AMD FSR 3 feature has been newly applied.

Additionally, if you're using the AMD Radeon RX 9000 series and have Adrenalin driver version 25.6.1 or later, you can enable FidelityFX Super Resolution 4 (FSR 4) via Adrenalin driver settings to use the feature.

However, even if your system meets the FSR 4 requirements, the in-game UI will display it as FSR 3.
Please note that while it is labeled FSR 3, FSR 4 is actually applied and functioning in-game.

. . .

Greetings from The First Berserker: Khazan.

We would like to inform you of the changes coming with the June 26 patch. 
Please refer to the details below.

[h3]📅 Update Schedule[/h3]
[list]
    [*]June 26, 2025, 5:30 PM (UTC)
    [*]Please note that the release schedule may vary by platform.
[/list]
[h3]🎮 Update Version[/h3]
[list]
    [*]STEAM®: Ver. 518753
    [*]PlayStation®5: Ver. 01.013.021
    [*]Xbox Series X|S: Ver. 1.1.13.21
[/list]
[h3]📌 Update Details[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Thank-You Gift
    [*]Balance Adjustments
    [*]System Changes
    [*]UI/UX Improvements
    [*]QoL Enhancements
    [*]Bug Fixes
[/list]

[h3][Thank-You Gift][/h3]

We have prepared a special reward for everyone who has enjoyed Khazan as a token of our gratitude.

For more details on the rewards and eligibility, please refer to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2680010/view/655950199566369719?l=english]A Thank-You Gift for Joining Us at the Start of Our Journey[/url] announcement.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

[b]🎁 Khazan (F) DLC[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/8b3169d0a25591574cbde28ff7327fb226d11a0c.png[/img]

[b]🎁 The First Berserker: Pathfinder Package[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/e6d5f1c399d445d4473c247129e44b33cc3868fb.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Berserker's Armor Set (M)
    [*]Ghost Knight's Armor Set (F)
    [*]3 Types of Hairstyles (M)
    [*]3 Types of Hairstyles (F)
    [*]Please note that the Pathfinder-exclusive HUD will be provided separately in July.
[/list]
[h3]Details[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Khazan (F) will be unlocked along with Change Appearance, and you can apply it by switching body types in the Change Appearance menu.
[list]
    [*]It can be used at the Change Appearance object located next to Qazumaka the Blacksmith in the underground area after entering the Crevice.
[/list]    [*]You can claim The First Berserker: Pathfinder Package from the Mailbox located in the Crevice after clearing Mission 2.
    [*]Rewards can only be viewed and claimed while online.
[list]
    [*]If you are online when the rewards are distributed, you must restart the game to check and claim the rewards.
    [*]If you are offline when the rewards are distributed, you can check and claim the rewards after connecting online.
    [*]If you are offline when the rewards are distributed but switched offline without claiming the rewards, you can check and claim the rewards after connecting online again.
[/list][/list]

[h3][b][Balance Adjustments][/b][/h3]

[h3][Ultimate Challenge] Reward[/h3]

The effects of gears granted as [Ultimate Challenge] mode rewards have been enhanced.
[list]
    [*]Radiant Darkness Set
[list]
    [*]Depleted: Stamina Recovery Rate Increase 30% for 10 sec → Depleted: Stamina Recovery Rate Increase 50% for 20 sec
    [*]Brink Guard: DMG Increase 4% for 10 sec (Max 5 stacks) → Brink Guard: DMG Increase 8% for 20 sec (Max 3 stacks)
    [*]Swift Attack: Spirit Gain 0.04 → Swift Attack: Spirit Gain 0.06
    [*]Brink Dodge: DMG Increase 10% for 15 sec (Max 3 stacks) → Brink Dodge: DMG Increase 15% for 20 sec (Max 3 stacks)
[/list]    [*]Defier Set
[list]
    [*]Brink Dodge: Health Recovery 5% → Brink Dodge: Health Recovery Increase 10%
    [*]Potent Blow: DMG Increase 1% for 7 sec (Max 15 stacks) → Potent Blow: DMG Increase 1.5% for 15 sec (Max 10 stacks)
    [*]Brink Dodge: DMG Increase 15% for 15 sec → Brink Dodge: DMG Increase 15% for 20 sec
    [*][Shadow Reversal]: DMG Increase 30% for 7 sec → [Shadow Reversal]: DMG Increase 35% for 20 sec
[/list]    [*]Netherworld Abyss Set
[list]
    [*]Received DMG Decrease 10% → Counterattack: Spirit Gain 1
    [*]Charged Attack: DMG Multiplier Increase 25% → Charged Attack: DMG Multiplier Increase 25%
    [*]Counterattack: Spirit Gain 1 → Spirit Skill: Stamina DMG Increase 10% for 20 sec (Max 3 stacks)
    [*][Counterstrike]: DMG Increase 30% for 7 sec → [Counterstrike]: DMG Increase 35% for 20 sec
[/list][/list]
[h3]Consumables[/h3]

Defeating monsters now has better drop rates for consumables crafting materials.
[list]
    [*]Transmutation Shards (common materials for consumables): 70% Increase
    [*]Spirit Orbs (materials for attribute consumables): 100% Increase
    [*]Inner Essence (material for combat resource management consumables): 60% Increase
    [*]Transmutation Mist (special material for consumables): 70% Increase
[/list]
[h3]Boss Battles[/h3]

The Exhausted durations have been increased for Yetuga, Blade Phantom, and Viper.
[list]
    [*]The duration of Yetuga’s exhaustion has been increased from 5 sec to 8 sec.
    [*]The duration of Blade Phantom’s exhaustion has been increased from 3 sec to 5 sec.
    [*]The duration of Viper Phase 1 and 2’s exhaustion has been increased from 5 sec to 7 sec.
[/list]
[h3]Difficulty[/h3]

Challenge and Hardcore difficulty balances have been partially adjusted.
[list]
    [*]Challenge Difficulty
[list]
    [*]Stamina Cost during Sprint has been reduced by half.
[/list]    [*]Hardcore Difficulty
[list]
    [*]Stamina Cost during Sprint has been reduced by half.
    [*]Stamina DMG Increase Rate has been reduced from 30% to 15%.
    [*]Brutal Attack DMG Increase has been removed.
    [*]DMG Received Increase Rate has been reduced from 50% to 20%.
[/list][/list]

[h3][b][System Changes][/b][/h3]

[h3]Augment Gear[/h3]

When augmenting gear, the level increase now depends on the grade of the material gear.
The grade of the target gear no longer affects the level increase.
[list]
    [*]Level Increase by Material Gear Grade:
[list]
    [*]Uncommon: Level +1
    [*]Rare: Level +2
    [*]Unique: Level +3
    [*]Epic: Level +4
    [*]Legendary: Level +5
[/list][/list]

[h3][b][UI/UX Improvements][/b][/h3]

[h3]Gear Names[/h3]

Gear items that can be obtained after defeating the final boss have been renamed as below.
[list]
    [*]Master of Chaos Set
[list]
    [*]Dual Wield of Chaos
    [*]Horns of Chaos
    [*]Claws of Chaos
    [*]Wings of Chaos
    [*]Shroud of Chaos
    [*]Gaiters of Chaos
[/list][/list]

[h3][b][Quality-of-Life Enhancements][/b][/h3]

[h3]Guide[/h3]

Completing trials in Stormpass now displays guides for each weapon.
[list]
    [*]Dual Wield
[list]
    [*]A combo that quickly closes in on the enemy
    [*]A combo that delivers a high-stagger preemptive attack
[/list]    [*]Greatsword
[list]
    [*]A combo that uses swift attacks
    [*]A combo that quickly closes in on the enemy
[/list]    [*]Spear
[list]
    [*]A combo for handling multiple enemies
    [*]A combo that closes in while dodging attacks
[/list][/list]
[h3]Danjin Shop[/h3]

The purchase limit for helms at the Danjin Shop has been removed.
[list]
    [*]After purchasing a helm from the Danjin Shop, the purchase quantity will reset once you clear a mission or enter the Crevice.
    [*]Helms purchased from the Danjin Shop can now be sold, dismantled, or discarded, and you can extract Lacrima from them.
[/list]
[h3]Spirit of Advocacy[/h3]

Summoning the Spirit of Advocacy required Lacrima of Circulation, which could be obtained by defeating the Revenant of Adversity.

Now, the Spirit of Advocacy can be summoned freely without using a Lacrima of Circulation.
[list]
    [*]Summoning the Spirit of Advocacy no longer consumes Lacrima of Circulation.
    [*]Related NPC dialogues will be partially revised accordingly.
[/list]

[h3][b][Bug Fixes][/b][/h3]

These are major bug fixes from this update that directly affect gameplay.

[h3]Common[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where players could become stuck on a certain terrain during the main mission, "Vaisar Gate".
    [*]Fixed an issue where Revenant of Adversity could not pass through a door at a certain location during the main mission, "Great Temple".
    [*]Fixed an issue where drop items would not fall to the ground when Corrupted Creations were defeated at a specific location in Vitalon.
    [*]Fixed an issue where a pillar of light continued to display at the same location in NG+ even after obtaining the "Prophecy 3" collection.
    [*]Fixed an issue where Elamein’s shield would occasionally fail to bounce off the ground when using the skill that throws the shield after spinning in midair during the boss battle.
    [*]Fixed an issue where the damage of “Limit Break: Apex” skill would increase abnormally when used on exhausted enemy after using the “Phantom: Night’s Veil” skill while both the fixed and set attributes of the Fleshripper set are active.
    [*]Fixed an issue where changing a gear preset during the use of Brutal Attack would make a monster stop moving but allows you to attack.
    [*]Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing the Gear Screen key after skipping a cutscene could intermittently cause a crash.
    [*]Replaced the image in Encyclopedia > Status Effects tab so that the Spirit Gauge does not appear to decrease under "Chaos".
    [*](English) Corrected the English item description text for the Scarlet Robin's Ring.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Improved the audio effects played abnormally when encountering the boss after the cinematic in the main mission "Skoffa Cave".
    [*]Added broken wall and floor debris objects to Daphrona's chamber in the Imperial Palace.
    [*]Improvements made to monsters becoming abnormally distorted when hit by the Dual Wield skill "Wind Piercer: Mark".
    [*]Improvements made to Potent Blow to trigger more quickly if it follows the use of the Greatsword skill "Mortal Blow".
    [*]Improvements made to cloud effects to display properly on the loading screen.
    [*]Improvements made to the camera to stop rotating automatically while using a skill.
[/list]

We are constantly monitoring your feedback and will review and apply further improvements as quickly as possible.

Thank you.

title: (Dev Note) The Background Behind the Difficulty Rework and the June Update
author: Khazan_CM
contents:
Hello Berserkers!
This is Junho Lee, Creative Director of The First Berserker: Khazan.

Before we dive into the details of what's coming,
I'd like to address something many of you have been curious about: the recent difficulty rework.

[h3]Why did we change the difficulty names?[/h3]

At launch, we set our intended standard experience as "Normal" and added a more accessible option labeled "Easy."
We figured that if players found the game too difficult, they'd simply switch to Easy. 
But when we looked at the data, we saw that many players just quit the game without ever changing the difficulty.

When we asked why, a lot of people said, "I'd rather quit with dignity than drop it down to Easy."
Some also said that if the default had been called "Hard" instead, they would've felt okay about switching down to "Normal."

Difficulty is subjective, and each player experiences Khazan's challenges differently.
That's why we offered multiple difficulty options from the start.
We wanted more people to enjoy Khazan, and we thought it would be better to let players freely adjust the challenge. We thought it was up to the player to lower it if it's too hard or raise it if it's too easy.

That's one of the biggest lessons I've learned from all of you.
So, we changed the difficulty names to give players more flexibility.
The old "Easy" is now called "Normal," and the old "Normal" is now "Challenge."
We also changed the default starting difficulty to "Normal."

[h3]Why did we add a Beginner difficulty?[/h3]

Many players recommended Khazan as a good entry point into hardcore action or Soulslike games, especially since it had an Easy mode.
But at the same time, we also heard a lot of feedback saying, "Sure, there's an Easy mode... but it's the hardest Easy mode I've ever played."

One of Khazan's strengths is that it offers selectable difficulty levels as a hardcore action game, so we wanted to expand that range and make it a game we could confidently recommend as a true starting point.
To that end, we didn't just adjust combat parameters. We also added quality-of-life features like enemy outlines when out of combat, so it's easier to recognize targets and engage at your own pace.

With this Beginner difficulty, I hope more players can jump into Khazan without feeling pressured, and, once they build confidence, take on the challenge of Normal or Challenge difficulty.

[h3]Why did we add a Hardcore difficulty?[/h3]

The truth is, Khazan's current difficulty has already been significantly toned down through extensive testing and polishing.
But for those who have already completed Khazan's challenging journey, we wanted to bring back that raw, intense thrill we originally envisioned.

During development, the early boss prototypes were brutally difficult, and we even considered compiling them into a separate game mode.
Unfortunately, aside from the difficulty, those early versions weren't polished enough to be released.

Instead, we created a new difficulty setting with a set of strict limitations designed to capture that same primal thrill.
While testing, we thought, "Maybe this is a bit too much?" So we added an attack damage bonus to soften the blow. But to our surprise, many of you cleared it more easily than expected.
For this patch, we're rolling it out in its pure form, exactly as we originally envisioned it.

We're also preparing improvements to address some of the inconveniences tied to the camera that's exclusive to this mode.
Based on many of your requests, we've added to our to-do list the option to use the Hardcore camera in other difficulties.

. . .

[h3][b]Now, let's get into the details of the June 27 update![/b][/h3]

This is probably what you've all been waiting for.

The Khazan (F) DLC will be available for free to everyone, and players who log in online by 4:29 PM on June 26 UTC will receive the Pathfinder Pack as a bonus!

For more information, please check out our previous announcement: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2680010/view/655950199566369719?l=english][A Thank-You Gift for Joining Us at the Start of Our Journey][/url].

[h3]Boss Exhaustion Duration Adjustment[/h3]

The exhaustion durations have been extended for early bosses: Yetuga, Blade Phantom, and Viper.
Exhaustion is one of the core mechanics of combat.
Enemies in an exhausted state take additional damage and can't put up a fight,
giving you a window to unleash free attacks, including the powerful Brutal Attack.

But we came to see that, since players are still getting used to the game when they're fighting these early bosses, the exhaustion window for early bosses may be too short. So we've increased it a bit.
We did go back and forth on it quite a bit because this could technically be seen as a boss nerf. Ultimately, we felt it was important to give players a bit more time to engage with and learn the exhaustion mechanic early on.

[h3]Combo Guide Improvements[/h3]

We've added tutorial guides to Stormpass that introduce each weapon's mechanics and basic combos during their respective trials.
These guides are designed to help new players quickly understand each weapon's unique features, try them out, and use simple combos right away.

[h3]Sprint Stamina Cost Reduction[/h3]

We found that adjusting Sprint Stamina cost in higher difficulties didn't actually make the game more challenging. It just made it more frustrating.
To deal with this aspect of the challenge, we've lowered the Sprint Stamina cost in both Challenge and Hardcore difficulties to match the Normal setting.
We also considered removing the cost entirely... but we'll need a bit more time to make that call.

[h3]Spirit of Advocacy Requirement Lowered[/h3]

We heard a lot of feedback that requiring a Lacrima of Circulation to summon a Spirit of Advocacy often disrupted boss progression. And I completely agree.
After careful consideration and multiple internal discussions, we've finally decided to remove this requirement.

[h3]Augment Gear Requirement Lowered & Danjin Shop Helm Purchase Limit Removed[/h3]

We received a lot of feedback on the augment gear system.

As I've mentioned several times on Discord, we believe this system needs a fundamental improvement.
But since that kind of change would require large-scale development, we've made some interim adjustments to address the immediate inconvenience.

Starting with this patch, inherited gear will receive a fixed level increase based on the grade of the material gear: Legendary: +5, Epic: +4, Unique: +3, and so on. 
We've also removed the one-time purchase limit on [b]Danjin Shop rewards, allowing you to buy them repeatedly without restrictions[/b].

[h3][Ultimate Challenge] Reward Improvements[/h3]

We've enhanced the performance of the set items obtainable through Great General's Crucible and Berserker's Bloodshed. 
Rewards earned from Great General's Crucible will also be upgraded from Epic to Legendary tier.
And we've increased the drop rates for consumable crafting materials so you can gather more resources more easily.

[h3]While not part of this patch, here's a quick preview of what we're working on behind the scenes:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Gear Tier Upgrade System
[list]
    [*]For example... you'll be able to upgrade Epic gear to Legendary.
[/list]    [*]Weapon Value (Scaling) Adjustment System
[list]
    [*]B, C weapon scaling values will be adjustable or upgradable.
[/list]    [*]Chance to Obtain Certain Items Upon Dismantling Gear
[list]
    [*]It has a chance to give you set crafting materials or grade upgrade items!
[/list]    [*]Lacrima of Circulation Sales
[list]
    [*]It might seem like a simple change, but replacing the existing item data in inventories will take a bit of work.
[/list][/list]
We're also working to improve some of the more tedious or frustrating sections in level-based gameplay, and looking to make leveling feel more rewarding overall.

[h3][b]And now, for an important announcement![/b][/h3]

The First Berserker: Khazan (Extended Original Game Soundtrack) will be released at 3 AM on June 27 UTC!
It features 33 hand-picked tracks in addition to the original launch OST and will be available on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@NePLi]Nepli's YouTube channel[/url] and on other music platforms.

We hope everything we've prepared brings even more enjoyment to all you Berserkers out there.
Thank you, truly, for your unwavering love and support for Khazan.

Sincerely, Junho Lee

. . .

※ Some terms may be subject to change as development progresses.

title: (Updated) [PC/PS/XBOX] Patch Notes – June 16
author: Khazan_CM
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/9acfc33173e0e1c1189e17effe483211d3d6c734.png[/img]

# (2025-06-18 2:15 UTC) The online demo service of The First Berserker: Khazan has been suspended on Xbox as of June 18, 2025. Thank you for understanding.

[b]📢 [PC/PS] Online Demo Temporarily Suspended[/b]

Hello Berserkers,
As of June 16, 2025, we will temporarily suspend the online demo service of The First Berserker: Khazan on Steam and PlayStation.
The online demo service for Xbox will be suspended at a later date, and the exact schedule will be announced separately.

Following steady updates after launch, the difference in game content between the demo version and the full game has grown significantly different.
We have, therefore, come to this decision as we strive to provide a more consistent experience across the board.

We will inform you in a separate notice once the online demo is ready again in the future.
Thank you for your understanding and patience.

. . .

Greetings from The First Berserker: Khazan.

We would like to inform you of the changes coming with the June 16 patch.
Please refer to the details below.

[h3]📅 Update Schedule[/h3]
[list]
    [*]June 16, 2025, 2:00 AM (UTC)
    [*]Please note that the release schedule may vary by platform.
[/list]
[h3]🎮 Update Version[/h3]
[list]
    [*]STEAM®: Ver. 516074
    [*]PlayStation®5: Ver. 01.011.008
    [*]Xbox Series X|S: Ver. 1.1.11.8
[/list]
[h3]📌 Update Details[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Balance Adjustments
    [*]System Changes
    [*]UI/UX Improvements
    [*]QoL Enhancements
    [*]Bug Fixes
[/list]

[h3][b][Balance Adjustments][/b][/h3]

[h3]Consumables[/h3]

[b]Developer's Comment:[/b]
Regarding the visual effect (light beam) for consumable discovery, we received feedback that the actual item received felt underwhelming compared to the grade speculated based on this visual effect.
To improve the sense of reward and resolve the mismatch between item grade and perceived value, we've adjusted the grade of select consumables.
These changes do not affect the item's drop location or spawn rate.

The grade of certain consumables will be adjusted to better reflect their reward value.
With these changes, the color of the visual effect displayed upon discovering consumables will also be updated accordingly.
[list]
    [*]Rare (Purple) → Uncommon (Blue)
[list]
    [*]Fire Spirit's Fuel
    [*]Water Spirit's Fuel
    [*]Lightning Spirit's Fuel
    [*]Earth Spirit's Fuel
    [*]Poison Spirit's Fuel
[/list]    [*]Unique (Red) → Rare (Purple)
[list]
    [*]Special Cleanse Potion
    [*]Special Parchment
[/list][/list]
[h3]Drop Rate Increase[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Defeating bosses in main missions now guarantees a 100% drop rate for set item crafting materials.
    [*]The drop rate for the Augment of Wisdom item has been increased. You can now acquire more Augments of Wisdom more easily.
[/list]

[h3][b][System Changes][/b][/h3]

[h3]Difficulty[/h3]

1. Existing difficulty levels have been renamed.
[list]
    [*](Before) Easy → (After) Normal
    [*](Before) Normal → (After) Expert
[/list]
2. Two new difficulty levels have been added.
[list]
    [*][Beginner] Difficulty: Designed for players new to action games.
[list]
    [*]Does not take Stamina DMG when hit.
    [*]Reduces the value of the attribute effect applied upon successful Brink Guard.
    [*]The character’s Attack DMG increases compared to [Normal] difficulty.
    [*]Deals more damage to enemies compared to [Normal] difficulty.
    [*]Brutal Attack's Attack DMG increases additionally compared to [Normal] difficulty.
    [*]The character's Health increases compared to [Normal] difficulty.
[/list]    [*][Hardcore] Difficulty: Designed for players with exceptional skill.
[list]
    [*]Greater penalty upon failing Reflection. (Damage Taken Increase)
    [*]The character’s Attack DMG increases compared to [Normal] difficulty.
    [*]Brutal Attack's Attack DMG increases additionally compared to [Normal] difficulty.
    [*]The character's Stamina and Defense decreases compared to [Normal] difficulty.
    [*]The character's Defense decreases compared to [Normal] difficulty.
[/list][/list]
[b]ℹ️ About [Hardcore] Difficulty[/b]
[list]
    [*]Completing a playthrough on Expert difficulty displays a notification that Hardcore difficulty has been unlocked.
    [*]You can select Hardcore difficulty when you start a new game from the main menu.
    [*]A tutorial will be shown when starting on Hardcore difficulty.
    [*]An exclusive camera lock-on perspective will be applied for Hardcore difficulty.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/cfd951681aaa605815c0cb01bf1a0e5c899f29f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/493acbb63ff971442cdb53ad53bfb839479996a0.png[/img]
[list]
    [*][b]Restrictions[/b]
[list]
    [*]Cannot change the difficulty level during a playthrough.
    [*]Cannot acquire or use the Phantom Form skill.
    [*]Cannot summon or upgrade the Spirit of Advocacy.
    [*]Cannot change attributes via Oksana.
    [*]Cannot see the enemy's Health, Stamina, and damage.
[/list][/list]
3. The difficulty selection process has been improved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/8674a1a8c047304e88e0532c48e7c6f4210dcc8a.png[/img]
[list]
    [*]Launching the game for the first time will display the Select Difficulty screen.
    [*]The previous difficulty selection screen has been removed.
[list]
    [*]After completing the main mission, "Heinmach"
    [*]After dying 3 times in the main mission, "Heinmach"
[/list][/list]
4. A difficulty-specific icon will appear on the battle HUD.

🔽 Beginner / Normal / Expert / Hardcore
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/af0861eb5ed34aed5a77f4dca70035e64282d541.png[/img]

5. The "Load" and "Retrieve Saved Data" menus now display the selected difficulty for each save.

[b]🔽 Load[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/1afb33da5a917b73f4c5cb3e5622ac48ef6ee804.png[/img]

[b]🔽 Retrieve Saved Data[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/d1c075a1d9a932428ec6a5138f783761f3e2c2b9.png[/img]

[h3]Skill Presets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/8ae3dfe7a9f40c5b6e3431f5ec49984f7afa7905.png[/img]

A new Skill Preset feature has been added to improve skill tree management.
[list]
    [*]You can save your current skill tree as a preset or load a previously saved one.
    [*]The Skill Preset menu can be accessed via the "Skill Tree" or "Manage Skills" screens.
    [*]You can register up to 10 skill presets.
[/list]
[b]ℹ️ Key Features[/b]
[list]
    [*]Register
[list]
    [*]The following data is saved in Skill Presets:
[list]
    [*]Skill Tree: Acquired skills and their levels on all pages, skill activation status, and equipped Spirit Skill status
    [*]Manage Skills: Equipped Spirit Skill info, activated Passive Skills by slot, and other Passive Skill activation status
[/list]    [*]Any existing data in the selected preset slot will be overwritten.
    [*]If any weapon skills are equipped at the time of saving, a warning popup will be displayed.
[/list]    [*]Reset
[list]
    [*]Once a preset is selected, a reset button will appear at the bottom of the screen.
    [*]Resetting a preset clears the slot and deletes the saved data.
[/list]    [*]Load
[list]
    [*]Loads a saved preset.
    [*]If no Weapon Skills are equipped when loading, a popup with a warning icon and message will be displayed.
[/list]    [*]Favorites
[list]
    [*]You can register an unlimited number of favorites.
    [*]The most recently favorited preset appears at the bottom and is marked with a favorite icon.
    [*]Unfavoriting a preset will return it to its original position.
[/list]    [*]Rename
[list]
    [*]Preset names may be duplicated and can include spaces, numbers, and special characters within a 40-byte limit.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Gear Presets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/433dc38a7b264e701f49649f0ca526d88d6f6b94.png[/img]

To allow easier switching between character setups, a new Gear Preset feature has been added.

title: (Dev Note) With Gratitude: On the June Update and Our Direction
author: Khazan_CM
contents:
Hello Berserkers,
This is Junho Lee, Creative Director of First Berserker: Khazan.

Around this time last year, I remember thinking, "By next spring, Khazan will be out…"
Now, summer is already upon us here in Korea. It's been three months since launch, almost 100 days now.
It hasn't been an easy journey, but thanks to your support and enthusiasm, Khazan has achieved great results so far. I'm truly grateful.

And now, I can finally reveal a spoiler I've been holding onto!
We're preparing a special gift as a token of our appreciation for everyone who has played the game since launch.
We'll be sharing more details in a separate announcement soon, so please hang tight.

Now, let's dive into the upcoming update!

[h3]Gameplay Experience Improvements[/h3]

We're finally adding some long-awaited features!

[list]
    [*]Skill Preset System added
    [*]Gear Preset System added
    [*]Inventory sorting by name added
    [*]Storage capacity increased from 100 to 500 slots
[/list]
We're also updating the drop rate for set item crafting materials from main mission bosses to 100% and increasing the drop rate for the Augment of Wisdom.

[h3]Combo Tutorial Added[/h3]

We've made it easier to learn various [b]skill combos[/b].
You'll now find a new "Combo" tab in the Encyclopedia, with basic combo guides for each skill tree level. Try checking out combo information and practicing directly in-game.

[h3]Difficulty System Improvements[/h3]

Big changes are coming to the [b]difficulty system[/b].
The current "Easy" difficulty will be renamed to "Normal," and "Normal" will become the default setting when starting a new game. The current "Normal" difficulty will be renamed to "Challenge."

A new difficulty [b]"Beginner"[/b] is being added.
This new setting includes added conveniences to help players who are new to action games learn Khazan's combat system in a more comfortable and less stressful way.
If the difficulty feels too low, you can always switch to "Normal" or "Challenge" at any time.

For those looking for a real challenge, we're adding a new [b]"Hardcore"[/b] difficulty.
"Hardcore" is a special difficulty that unlocks after completing the first playthrough on "Challenge."
It can be started as a New Game, and difficulty cannot be changed mid-playthrough.

As the toughest difficulty, Hardcore hides monster HP and Stamina gauges. Support systems such as the Spirit of Advocacy, Phantom Form, and Change Attributes are also disabled.
Hardcore also features its own balance settings and a unique camera lock-on perspective, offering a fresh and intense way to experience Khazan.

[h3]Online Demo Temporarily Suspended[/h3]

Following steady updates after launch and the major difficulty revamp in this patch, the gameplay experience between the demo version and the full game has grown significantly different.
We have therefore decided to suspend access to the demo version for now and will reassess our future plans before providing an update.
We appreciate your understanding as we strive to provide a more consistent experience across the board.

. . .

[h3]About Our Patch Philosophy[/h3]

We've consistently worked to improve the game by listening closely to your feedback both before and after Khazan's release.

We believe that game design isn't something set in stone. It's something we shape and refine together with our players.
That's why the most important question we ask ourselves when reviewing feedback is: "Does this expand Khazan gameplay experience?"
Our goal isn't just to remove inconveniences. It's to help players better understand and enjoy the game.

For example, the previous balance patch included a nerf to the "Trance" spear build.
Even though this might be less fun for existing players, we made this decision because we believe it is more important to provide new players with an experience and environment where they can explore various playstyles and carve out their own paths.

Before the patch, the "Trance spam" build was widely seen as the only viable option while other styles were considered inefficient or not worth using. This seemed counter to our intent, which is for players to better understand the game, discover diverse strategies, and develop their own playstyles.

Our approach is to support diverse playstyles and find the in-game balance by improving underused skills and builds rather than weakening strong ones.
However, in the case of "Trance," the performance gap compared to other weapons and skills was simply too large, and a nerf was unavoidable.

We realize no balance patch can be perfect. Even so, we've done our best to find the most reasonable middle ground.
After this patch, we'll continue to collect feedback and work toward a game experience that satisfies as many players as possible.

We're deeply grateful for your continued support, patience, and willingness to share your thoughts, even if the direction of a patch wasn't what you hoped for.
We're especially careful when it comes to balance-related feedback. Each comment is thoroughly reviewed, and we closely monitor gameplay data to track trends and identify where future adjustments may be needed.

We'll keep pushing forward in every way we can to make this game even better.
Thank you, truly, for your unwavering love and support for Khazan.

Sincerely, Junho Lee

. . .

※ Some terms are subject to change depending on the development progress.

title: (Dev Note) May Update Announcement and the Future Development Roadmap
author: Khazan_CM
contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/f43e126fbf4af78c2dbf700b846461ea02249d25.png[/img]

Hello, Berserkers.
This is Junho Lee, Creative Director of The First Berserker: Khazan.

Not too long ago, while I was answering questions on Discord, I had a moment where I suddenly found myself tearing up. One of our players, who had shared so many thoughtful suggestions with us, left a farewell message before setting off on a new journey. Reading their final words really struck a chord deep inside me.

When you run an online game, farewells between players and developers usually aren't the prettiest moments. At least, that's been my experience most of the time. If a bond is strong enough, you find ways to stay connected, right?

Maybe that's why... a part of me has always been scared of saying goodbye to our players. Even though I knew no meeting or connection could last forever, I kept thinking, "I hope they don't get disappointed in Khazan," or "I hope they don't leave."

But this time, the farewell felt different. We hadn't known each other before, but we met through Khazan—talked on Discord, shared our experiences, and rooted for each other. And in the end, we exchanged thanks, wished each other well for what's ahead, and promised to meet again someday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781270/5a50ad6019f5278231c9af1336c4775cd8fc619b.png[/img]

. . .

For a few days after that, I found myself stuck in this strange, lingering feeling.

And I made a promise to myself: to work even harder—really, really harder—and come back better than ever. When we meet again, I want everyone who once loved Khazan to feel, "Yeah, this is the game I fell in love with," and love it even more. I want this bond between us to become something even stronger. Those were the thoughts that stayed with me.

Hmm, writing all this out... it kinda feels like I'm in a coming-of-age manga, haha. This vibe doesn't suit a hardcore action game...!

(*Clears Throat*) Hello again, everyone. This is Junho Lee, Director of the [b]Dark Fantasy Hardcore Action RPG[/b], Khazan.
Alright, time to get back on track—let's dive into the update news you've all been waiting for.


[h3][b]Introducing the Next Update[/b][/h3]

The long-awaited May update is finally here!
When we wrapped up the preparation for the official launch and began designing new content, the very first keyword that came to our mind was "boss".

Khazan is a mission-orientated game. You can always go back and fight the bosses that you defeated again, and you'll still earn rewards. Want a tougher challenge? Unequip your gear or limit your skills to raise the difficulty as much as you'd like. But for this new content, we wanted to create a special challenge—something different from the usual approach.

We had a storm of ideas. Harder. Nastier. More punishing. The kind of challenge that not just anyone could take on. Then, one of our developers said:

"Yeah… I probably wouldn't play that."

And just to be clear—this person? (He's our Lead Character Designer.)
Plays games over 4 hours a day, has earned platinum trophies in most action titles, and refuses to consider a game "complete" without one. They even love Boss Rush content. (And yes, we have more than a few people like that on our team.)

This was one of the hardest parts of designing Khazan and new content.

[b]"Hardcore difficulty"[/b]
How do we determine the measure of a "hardcore" difficulty? What's the point of content if no one can enjoy it? But then again, if it's not a worthy challenge, which is at the core of our value, is it really the right call?

We knew we wanted something players could challenge themselves with. But we also knew it couldn't just be hard for the sake of being hard. It had to be fun, something that's tough but rewarding. A mode you'd be proud to conquer and eager to show off.

Taking all of this into account, we picked two ideas from our brainstorming session. Then came long hours of debate, testing, and refinement. And finally—we found one that made us go:
"This is worth the challenge."
"This is something I'd be proud to tell others about once I clear it."
And now, we're excited to show you those two new modes.

[b]Two new Boss Rush (Ultimate Challenge) modes are coming as part of this update.[/b]
Once you beat the game and see the ending, a new menu will appear on the title screen.
Because every boss in Khazan is deeply tied to the story, even showing the boss list would spoil things. That's why this new boss rush content will only be available after completing the game. (We know there were boss spoilers in a previous patch note—rest assured, we'll take every precaution to make sure that never happens again!)

The two Boss Rush modes differ in difficulty and progression, but I'll give you a brief overview here.
[list]
[*] [b]"Great General’s Crucible"[/b] – Fight through groups of thematically organized bosses, unlocking the next theme each time you clear one. You'll fight with designated specs (gear, level, skills, etc.), and completing all of them will earn you a special reward.
[*] [b]"Berserker’s Bloodshed"[/b] – Make your character stronger with rewards earned from consecutive fights, and push all the way to defeat the final boss. As a final reward, you can earn powerful new weapons and set items.
[*] We're really curious to see how you Berserkers will actually feel the difficulty, compared to how it was envisioned by the combat designers in our dev team. Please send us lots of feedback! (It'll be a big help in fine-tuning the difficulty for future content.)
[/list]
[b]Also, Change Appearance will now be available even during your first playthrough.[/b] You can unlock it by completing the Blacksmith's Heirloom mission.

For more detailed information, please check out the patch notes.

[b]The expected update date is Thursday, May 15.[/b]
We're almost done with the final phase to ensure the best possible quality. As I mentioned before, the update still needs to pass QA and platform certification, and if any stability issues or quality concerns arise, it might take a little longer.
I'd like to share just the fully locked-in contents with you, and I ask for your understanding where this is concerned. We'll do everything we can to stick to the schedule we announced.


[h3][b]Introducing What Comes After the Next Update[/b][/h3]

Yes, that's right! I'm about to introduce the update that'll follow the May 15 (Thu) update I just described!

[h3]Regarding Shortcut Resets and Faster Boss Retry Improvements[/h3]

Over the past month, we've worked really hard to find a way to improve this. But long story short... we concluded that it wouldn't be possible. I do apologize. This issue stems from my failure to prepare for it in advance.

The improvement itself isn't complicated or technically impossible. For example, we could simply adjust the reset conditions for each shortcut object. That way, like treasure chests, they would stay open when restarting the mission instead of closing again.

So, why do we think we won't be able to improve it? Let me give you an example from the Embars mission. In Embars, there are huge structures you can interact with. Each interaction rotates them to block or open new paths. If we modify these objects, the mission will be reset when the updated objects are loaded.

The problem is that every player is at a different point in their progress. Applying a patch under these conditions would cause many players to be unable to continue their missions normally. (In the reviews we conducted, we found that this issue wouldn't just affect complex missions like Embars or El Ravaca but most missions overall.)

We truly wrestled with this decision until the very end. "After the patch, should we reset all ongoing missions?"
But ultimately, we decided not to. There are three reasons why.
[list]
[*] First, resetting ongoing missions would cause players to feel a huge sense of loss. For example, if I were fighting against Maluca or the final boss and suddenly received a patch that forced me to restart the mission from the beginning... I knew it would feel terrible.
[*] Second, while resetting missions would improve stability, it wouldn't change the fact that all content would have to be modified, requiring an enormous amount of testing. NG+ would also need to be thoroughly tested, which could cause significant delays to new content updates.
[*] Third, even if the reset worked normally, we would still have to thoroughly verify all potential risks, such as save file corruption or progression errors.
[/list]
In conclusion, although we tried our best to improve shortcut resets and faster boss retries, we won't be able to implement them this time. If we had been able to prepare for this before release, it could have been handled much more easily... It's something I deeply regret. I sincerely apologize.

Instead, we plan to add the following [b]quality-of-life features to minimize inconveniences[/b].
[list]
[*] [b]New items added to allow fast traveling to the Crevice or the last Blade Nexus you interacted with:[/b] We'll be adding items that let you instantly move to the Crevice or to the last Blade Nexus you interacted with. These will be provided as permanent items, not consumables.
[*] [b]Added teleport between from one Blade Nexus to another:[/b] You'll be able to freely move from one Blade Nexus to another activated in the same mission. Interacting with a Blade Nexus will display a list of available destinations.
[*] After clearing certain [b]missions for farming purposes, you will now start right in front of the Spectral Portal[/b] before entering that mission. You'll no longer have to travel long distances through the Mortal World for a quick retry.
[/list]
This update will include various changes, such as a [b]buff to Phantom Form Mode[/b].
We'll share more detailed information in the next Dev Note.

[h3]We are currently targeting a late May to early June release for this update.[/h3]


[h3][b]Introducing What Comes After the Next Two Updates[/b][/h3]

Yes, that's right! This is a preview of the update that will follow the late May update I just explained above.
Since there's still a bit of time left, I'll keep it brief for now.
[list]
[*] [b][Balance Adjustment] Skill balance adjustments for Dual Wield, Greatsword, and Spear[/b]
[*] [b][Balance Adjustment] Adjustment to set effect configurations[/b]
[*] [b][New System] Skill Presets[/b]
[*] [b][New System] Gear Presets[/b]
[*] [b][New System] Increase Gear Grades[/b]
[*] [b][New System] Change Weapon Scaling[/b]
[*] [b][QoL] New Sorting Option: Sorting Items by Name[/b]
[*] [b][QoL] Storage Expansion[/b]
[*] [b]And... More Special Contents Coming[/b]
[/list]
[h3]We are currently targeting a mid-June release for this update.[/h3]


[h3][b]Regarding Update and Development Progress[/b][/h3]

After the previous Dev Note and patch notes, we received a lot of questions like, "When will Feature A be updated?" and "When will Improvement B be applied?" So, in this Developer's Note, I'd like to briefly summarize the current development status and plans.

Sometimes, issues that seemed simple when we first received feedback turn out to be much more complicated once we start discussing and reviewing them for an actual patch (as I mentioned earlier regarding shortcut resets). There are also many platform-specific issues, with different problems occurring on Steam, Xbox, and PlayStation. Because of this, there are still areas I haven't been able to fully share yet.

However, one principle never changes. Our top priority is always to ensure that [b]players can enjoy Khazan in a stable environment.[/b] We make it a point to identify and resolve critical issues as quickly as possible, regardless of how often they occur. After that, we work on improving areas that need quality-of-life updates, one by one, to create a smoother and more enjoyable experience. These improvement efforts are treated with almost the same priority as developing new content.

I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has shared their feedback and suggestions on Discord. We'll continue doing our best to reflect your valuable input and deliver an even better experience.

I hope our first new piece of content will be an enjoyable experience for you.
Thank you.

Sincerely, Junho Lee

. . .

* Some terms are subject to change depending on the development progress.

title: (Dev Note) Khazan's Next Step: April Update Preview
author: Khazan_CM
contents:
Hello, Berserkers.
This is Junho Lee, Creative Director of The First Berserker: Khazan.

First, I want to sincerely thank everyone who's been enjoying Khazan.

Every time we watch gameplay clips shared on platforms like YouTube and TikTok, the entire dev team—including myself—is both amazed and deeply moved. Since Khazan is a game where the rhythm of combat and overall enjoyment vary greatly [b]depending on how you use combos[/b], we find ourselves watching a lot of combo videos. Every time we see your creative combos and awesome battle scenes, we're not only impressed—we're learning from them, too.

And to everyone who's shared feedback on Discord and other communities with the hope of making Khazan an even better game—we truly appreciate it.


[h3][b]Main Features of the Upcoming Patch[/b][/h3]

The next patch is ready and is currently awaiting final QA and platform review. [b]We'll share the full details in the patch notes[/b], but for now, here's a quick look at a few of the changes we think you've been most looking forward to.

[h3]Fix for the "Standing Alone" Achievement[/h3]
We think this might be the one most of you have been waiting for. The achievement has been updated so that [b]it can now be completed as long as you don't summon the Spirit of Advocacy during your second playthrough—even if you summoned it in your first.[/b]
This is also in response to a question from Discord user hayyeeQQ.

Honestly, we'd love to go in and manually complete the achievement for everyone who's already met the condition, but we've found that doing so would require platform-level account changes, which are outside the dev team's control... We're truly sorry about that.

Once the patch goes live, all records of having summoned the Spirit of Advocacy will be reset. From that point on, if you defeat the final boss without summoning the soul, the achievement will unlock.
Even if you've already completed a third run (NG++), you won't need to start a new game—you can still earn the achievement. Likewise, as long as you defeat the final boss again without summoning the Spirit of Advocacy, the achievement will be completed.

[h3]Difficulty Change From Easy to Normal[/h3]
You can now switch from Easy to Normal difficulty at any time.
Likewise, you can switch from Normal back to Easy whenever you want. (Of course, that part was already possible...)
Please keep in mind you can't make changes during your playthrough of the final mission and in the ending zone.

[h3]Improved Visibility of Hidden Danjin's Jars[/h3]
Previously, there was a feature that used sound and vibration cues when you approached a hidden jar. However, players using a keyboard and mouse could only rely on the sound. To make them easier to find, this patch adds visual indicators to help you spot hidden jars.
In addition, both the strength of the vibration and the sound cues have been fine-tuned for improved detection.

[h3]"Khazan's Memories" Improvements[/h3]
A tutorial has been added to guide players the first time they enter the Khazan's Memories menu.
You can now navigate Khazan's Memories using both a mouse and the D-Pad.
If you have completed Khazan's Memories or have enough Vengeance Points to upgrade abilities, a red dot notification will appear.
A new reset button has also been added, allowing you to redistribute your ability points.

[h3]Main Menu Improvements[/h3]
You can now open the main menu at any time during a mission to check your Soulstones, collected Danjin's Jars, and any lost Lacrima.

[h3]Red Dot Notifications[/h3]
[b](When upgrades are available)[/b] A red dot will now appear when you can claim rewards or enhance through systems like Phantom, Khazan's Memories, or the Spirit of Advocacy. Now you won't need to open each menu one by one just to check anymore.
 
[b](When new crafting recipes are available)[/b] If new recipes are registered by speaking with Blacksmith Duimuk, any newly added craftable items will also be marked with a red dot.

[h3]Elemental Resistance Now Affects Environmental Status Effects[/h3]
Khazan's elemental resistances will now affect status effects that cover an area, such as burning fields or poison swamps, reducing their impact.

[h3]Improved Character Growth Experience[/h3]
After the patch, leveling up one Phantom will make it faster to raise the next. We've improved the progression experience so players can grow various Phantoms more smoothly and build up their characters more efficiently.
We've also adjusted the skill proficiency gain system so that skilled players—or those who focus on dodge mechanics—won't be at a disadvantage when increasing their skill mastery.

[h3]World Map Mission Indicators Improved[/h3]
We've fixed the issue where it was unclear whether missions shown on the world map had been cleared.

[h3]Daphrona's Codex Improvements[/h3]
Now, when you discover a new monster and it's added to the bestiary, its elemental weakness information will also be displayed.

[h3]Gear Screen Improvements+[/h3]
A new "Sort by Performance" option has been added. Weapons can now be sorted by Attack, and armor by Defense. (Please hang in there just a bit longer for the "Sort by Name" option...!)

If a gear item grants a skill through a unique or set effect, you can now view the skill's description and a preview video via the "Help" option. When a new skill becomes available through gear, you'll now have the option to equip it immediately.

Also, you can now quickly check the current status of your set items. If you have other set items that are not currently equipped, they'll be marked with a white icon.
(Even if those items are stored in your storage, they'll still appear with a white icon. If you can't find them in your inventory, be sure to check the storage!)

[h3]Lock-On System Improvements+[/h3]
The lock-on system has been reworked to function more practically.

A new option has been added in the "System - Settings" menu that lets you choose whether the lock-on direction is based on the camera or your character. We've set the default to camera direction as it tends to be more intuitive. However, if you prefer, you can switch the setting so that lock-on aligns with the direction your character is facing.

Also, the "System - Settings" menu now includes a toggle for the camera reset function. When you attempt to lock on but there's no valid target, the camera will automatically reorient to match Khazan's facing direction. You can choose to enable or disable that feature.

There's a lot more coming in this update, so be sure to check out the full patch notes for all the details.


[h3][b]Our Update Philosophy[/b][/h3]

When preparing updates, our top priority is ensuring nothing breaks your immersion during gameplay. That's why we focus first on [b]minimizing unexpected bugs and lag[/b], while also [b]enhancing the quality of existing systems[/b]. At the same time, we're working on [b]new content[/b] you'll be able to enjoy right after.

Of course, we know it's frustrating to wait for fixes to the issues you're facing, and we apologize for the inconvenience.
But thorough testing is absolutely essential to prevent a small fix from leading to a bigger problem. The First Berserker: Khazan is packed with content, so even a single change needs to be carefully checked for highly specific scenarios or unexpected situations. We're doing everything we can to ensure every patch makes the game more enjoyable and more stable.

Thank you so much for your patience.
Thank you so much for your support.
And thank you so much for having fun with us.

We're working hard every day to repay that support with gratitude.
We'll be back soon with news on what's coming next.

Sincerely, Junho Lee
